company.name: Cashfree Payments
company.shortDescription: Cashfree Payments is a fintech company that provides payment processing, payouts, and API banking solutions for businesses.
company.description: Cashfree Payments is a payments and banking technology company that enables many businesses to accept and send money efficiently. The platform supports various payment modes including UPI, cards, net banking, and wallets, alongside features like instant refunds and loan disbursements. Cashfree Payments provides a Merchant app for businesses to manage their payments and access their accounts anytime, anywhere.
